title: Compact recommendation timeline and transactional rollback for Optimize cards
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Deliver a compact, developer-friendly UX for Optimize that surfaces batching and caching recommendations as lightweight cards with an immutable diff preview and a transactional apply/rollback history. This ticket covers the card render variants (compact vs expanded), a change-diff preview modal tied to configuration commits, and a per-customer audit timeline that records who applied/reverted changes and why. The flow must enable safe one-click dry-run, batched application across related routes, and a reversible transaction with automatic fallback when any staged change fails.

Scope (this ticket):
- Recommendation card variants and UX affordances for quick scan and deep inspection.
- Diff preview UI that shows before/after config with tokenized highlights and estimated cost delta.
- Safe apply orchestration hooks in the Console to create a transactional commit and record an entry in Apply History.
- Rollback UX and automated revert operation with reason capture and optional customer notification entry.
- Audit trail entries surfaced in the Console: who initiated, commit SHA, timestamp, affected routes/models, and telemetry link.

Out of scope: backend orchestration impl details beyond the control-plane API contract, on-prem upgrade agent changes, and billing engine changes (handled by ENG billing team).
acceptance_criteria: Compact cards show recommendation summary, delta estimate, and one-click preview
Preview modal displays line-level config diffs with tokenized highlights and an estimated monthly cost delta
Apply action creates a transactional commit visible in Apply History with status (Pending / Applied / Failed / Rolled back)
Failed applies are automatically rolled back and leave a clear audit entry with failure reason and link to job logs
Users can trigger manual rollback from the Apply History UI and must provide a rollback reason before completion
Telemetry emitted for preview open, apply start, apply success/failure, and rollback with relevant IDs for correlation
qa_notes: QA should exercise: compact->expand transitions, diff preview highlighting across JSON/YAML variants, simultaneous apply attempts (race), failure injection to confirm automatic rollback, and manual rollback flow. Run load test to ensure preview rendering for accounts with 10k+ recommendation entries doesn't time out.
rollout_plan: Feature-flag roll out: start behind ff 'optimize_compact_cards' on staging. Canary to 5% of accounts for 72h, validate telemetry and Apply History integrity, then 50% for 48h, then full release. Provide beta opt-in for early enterprise partners. If high failure rate observed (>1% apply failure), automatically rollback flag and open a postmortem.
telemetry: Events: optimize.card.preview.open, optimize.card.apply.start, optimize.card.apply.success, optimize.card.apply.failure, optimize.card.rollback.start, optimize.card.rollback.complete. All events include customer_id, account_region, commit_id, actor_id, affected_routes (list), and cost_estimate_delta.
migration_notes: Existing Apply History entries must remain readable. The new transactional commits will include a new 'transaction_id' field; ingestion pipelines must gracefully ignore unknown fields. Notify data-team to add transaction_id to the audit exports schema.
